description: Propose handing one or more tasks to another participant or a group, with the context needed to pick them up. Every task must currently be assigned to the proposer.

context_links.description: URLs to threads, tickets or documents the recipient will need.

summary.description: Covering note for the handover as a whole, above the per-task detail.

tasks.description: The work being handed over, one entry per task. Every task must currently be assigned to the proposer; otherwise the proposal is refused with -32050.

blockers.description: What is preventing progress, if anything.

next_action.description: What the recipient should do first.

status_summary.description: Where the work has reached, and what has already been tried.

to.description: Recipient, as a participant URI or a group URI such as 'group:support-team'. A recipient who is not a workspace member is refused with -32052.

name: chap.handoff.propose
